rule.name: HttpValueCase
rule.message: This compares exact text, but media types, charsets, encodings, URI schemes and hosts, cookie name prefixes and file extensions are case-insensitive, so Application/JSON, HTTPS or photo.PNG is missed. Lowercase the value first (value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) or use equalsIgnoreCase, or parse it: MediaType.parseMediaType(value) and MimeTypeUtils for media types, URI.getScheme() compared with equalsIgnoreCase. Header names read with getHeader or HttpHeaders ignore case already.
